name: @jixoai/ui-betlang-wasm
description: The betlang statistical language detector as a wasm npm package (betlang =0.1.1, MIT, DioxusLabs): a ~40-line handwritten loader speaking raw linear memory (no wasm-bindgen), detect() returning the 48-label model enum index plus a calibrated top-1 confidence. Built by scripts/build.mjs from the crates.io pin with a sparse-index checksum gate; ARTIFACT.md records the as-shipped bytes.
